title: ID0429544-DC/Si-D/TH-[MP / R3 170001691] Outlet 2: outoforder
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
Connector 2 is not working and cannot be used for charging.
Solution: made DC 2 operative and outlet 2 is available and no response from customer.

additional_info.subject: Issue with Connector 2 – Korat, Thailand Charger
additional_info.body:
Dear Support Team,
I hope this message finds you well.
I would like to report an issue with the charger installed at our Korat, Thailand site. Although the unit has two connector heads, only one is currently functional.
Connector 2 is not working and cannot be used for charging.
For your reference, I’ve attached images that show both connectors being tested. As seen in the photos, only one of them is operating normally.
Please advise on the next steps for troubleshooting or repair. Let me know if any further information is required.
Thank you for your support.
Best regards,
Rattanathon

additional_info.subject: Re: ID0429544-DC/Si-D/TH-[MP / R3 170001691] Outlet 2: outoforder CRM:02682000127
additional_info.body:
Dear Vikas,
We had intentionally set
Outlet 2
to "inoperative" because it was not functioning properly and could not be used for charging. To prevent users from attempting to use it, we made the decision to deactivate it.
If possible, could you please check the charger logs around
June 2nd, 2025
, which is when we originally encountered the issue (as shown in the
first image
) You will see that Connector 2 was unable to charge.
Additionally, I’ve attached a
second image
to this email showing that the connector was turning
on and off by itself
, which led us to deactivate it for safety and usability reasons.
Please help us verify whether the connector is now fully functional. Once confirmed, we will proceed accordingly and let you know if the case can be closed.
Best regards,
Rattanathon Boonskulsopit

additional_info.subject: Re: ID0429544-DC/Si-D/TH-[MP / R3 170001691] Outlet 2: outoforder CRM:02682000127
additional_info.body:
Dear Rattanathon Boonskulsopit,
We have observed that the charger is experiencing authentication issues and is currently running on an older firmware version (v4.0.11).
To address these issues, we recommend upgrading the charger’s firmware. Firmware updates typically include important bug fixes, performance improvements, and enhanced compatibility with electric vehicle communication protocols. Updating to the latest version should help resolve the authentication errors and improve overall reliability.
After the firmware update, we will closely monitor the upcoming charging sessions and keep you informed.
Please let us know if we have your approval to proceed with the firmware update and when would be a suitable time to carry it out.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vikas Khiladkar
